$comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — do NOT copy to vercel.json yet.
Vercel Hobby allows only DAILY cron jobs (once per day) and a limited
number of invocations; a sub-daily schedule like '*/5 * * * *' FAILS
deployment on Hobby. Pro plans allow per-minute schedules.
Until the plan is known, prefer Supabase-side scheduling: pg_cron +
pg_net can call this endpoint on any interval with the CRON_SECRET
bearer (see docs/ops/email.md). Alternatively deploy this file's
'crons' block when a Pro plan is confirmed.
